description: Kpler brings maritime and commodities market intelligence into ChatGPT. Users can track vessels via AIS, look up port calls and voyage routes, analyze commodity trade flows and supply/demand balances, monitor refinery throughput and margins, follow LNG terminal capacity, inventories, utilization and outages, review freight-market fixtures and port congestion, run vessel compliance and sanctions-risk screening, and read Kpler Insights reports and market commentary. Every tool is a read-only query against Kpler's authenticated data, so the app answers analytical questions without creating, modifying, or deleting anything.
